svg.title: Figure26 Authorization Scope Propagation and Delegation Boundary Model
svg.desc: NEW-shot2play Protocol Suite Version 2.0. Controlled authorization scope propagation, scope narrowing, delegation boundaries, service boundaries, resource boundaries, cross-service verification, and reauthorization.
svg.text: Figure26 Authorization Scope Propagation and Delegation Boundary Model
Originating Authorization → Controlled Propagation → Boundary Verification → Effective Scope → Execution
Scope actually available to downstream execution
Original Subject → Authorization Domain → Service A
→ Delegated Service B → Delegated Service C
Each delegation step SHALL remain within the authority
Direct Trust · Federated Trust · Cryptographic Trust · Trusted Internal Reference · Explicit Delegation
External parties SHALL NOT receive unrestricted authority from an internal authorization decision.
Boundary crossing MAY require Independent Authentication · Restricted Scope · Delegation Token · Reauthorization
